documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for To Consider Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported its highest-ever quarterly sales, EBITDA, profit before tax, and PAT for Q1 FY27, driven by healthy demand, improved operational efficiencies, and cost optimization. The company remains confident about sustaining its growth momentum due to robust underlying demand in the automotive and engineering sectors, a strong order pipeline, and potential new business volumes from recent international visits. Management highlighted significant margin improvements across segments, particularly in brakes, and noted that current infrastructure is sufficient to support projected revenue growth over the next two years without major land expansions. Menon Bearings reported its highest-ever consolidated quarterly revenue of Rs. 94.04 crore, EBITDA of Rs.

guidance.claim: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: For the current year, management is targeting Alkop revenue of INR100 crores and around INR125 crores for next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: Management stated that INR360 crores is a conservative revenue figure for the year.
guidance.quote: And we have told INR360 crore is a conservative number.

guidance.claim: Management targets a revenue growth rate of 25% year-on-year for the next few years.
guidance.quote: And again, we will be sustaining this because of increase in the overall turnover which we are targeting at a rate of 25% year-on-year for next few years.

guidance.claim: The company aims to reach INR 500 crores in revenue by 2028.
guidance.quote: And we will take all-out efforts to see how we can reach INR500 crores by '28.

guidance.claim: Management expects to maintain EBITDA margins between 20% and 22% during the next two years.
guidance.quote: I again assure you that considering the present situation going forward, we will be able to maintain EBITDA more than 20% and it should be about between 20% to 22% during next two years.

guidance.claim: Management estimates the revenue for FY27 to exceed INR 360 crores.
guidance.quote: Precisely, what we have estimated is more than INR 360 crores.

guidance.claim: Aluminium division Alkop is expected to grow at a rate of 29% for the next two years.
guidance.quote: And again, I repeat here that Alkop for next 2 years will grow at a rate of 29%.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects visits to Canada and the USA to yield substantial volumes in the coming period.
demand_outlook.quote: That is because, more particularly, due to our last month's visit to Canada and USA, is expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to operate within its primary segment of auto components where sustained demand is observed.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to operate within our primary segment of auto components where we are seeing sustained demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports to the USA market have increased by almost 50% over the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: So far as USA market is concerned, our exports have gone up by almost 50% over last year so far as USA market is concerned and there is a lot of opportunities we are looking for.

demand_outlook.claim: European countries are looking to divert their volumes and businesses from China to India and are approaching the company with inquiries.
demand_outlook.quote: Since European countries are looking to divert their volumes and businesses from China to India and they are tapping our doors and we'll be very happy to see that they come into our fold from the next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Menon Alkop has a planned CapEx of around INR4 crores for the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: The dynamometer for the brake segment is under construction and expected by the end of August.
capex_expansion.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

capex_expansion.claim: For brake capacity, Rs. 0.58 crore was fully deployed in FY26 with Rs. 2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹0.58 crore fully deployed in FY26 with ₹2.50 crore additional planned over next 2 years

capex_expansion.claim: Planned capital expenditure for Alkop is INR 7 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And for Alkop, it is INR7 crores and brakes, it is INR3 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded highest-ever sales, EBITDA, profit before tax, and PAT in its history for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The first quarter of FY26-'27 has been a strong and encouraging one for the company and I am glad to tell you that we have recorded highest-ever sales, highest-ever EBITDA, highest-ever profit before tax and PAT in the history of the company for this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Bi-metal segment sales increased year-on-year by 40.41% and EBITDA is up by approximately 60%.
margins_costs.quote: Now coming to the standalone performance of Bi-metal Menon Bearings, during the quarter sales increased to INR67.06 crores from INR47.76 crores as compared to the corresponding quarter of the last year that is year-on-year increase of 40.41% and further increased by about 41%. EBITDA is up by ~60%.
And total income increased by 37.05%. And EBITDA on a consolidated basis is up by 57%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin in the brakes segment reached 25% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

margins_costs.claim: Carbide tool prices for all automobile manufacturers have increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

margins_costs.claim: The company was successful in passing on the burden of raw material price increases to customers to a larger extent.
margins_costs.quote: so far as material consumption is here raw material prices are going up, we were successful in passing on that burden of raw material to the customers to the larger extent.

margins_costs.claim: Export margins are consistently better than aftermarket or OEM margins.
margins_costs.quote: That is for exports, where margins are always better than aftermarket or OEM.

margins_costs.claim: Alkop's average realization of value addition stands at INR 700 to INR 750.
margins_costs.quote: where Alkop's average realization is INR750, INR700.

margins_costs.claim: The aluminium division operates at around 20% margins compared to competitors working at 6% to 8% margins.
margins_costs.quote: where in the aluminium division also we are working at around 20% margins. So, that's the difference between Menon Alkop and other players in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: Peak revenue from the bi-metal division can be above INR400 crores without land expansion.
orders_capacity.quote: Peak revenue from this, it can be aboveINR400 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The new development parts pipeline includes 51 new parts representing a business value of almost INR 30 crores within this year and next year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our new development parts pipeline is robust with 51 new parts across major customers like John Deere for India domestic and exports as well. Eaton, Taco Prestolite and Mayekawa representing a business value of almost INR 30 crores within this year and next year.

orders_capacity.claim: The Bi-Metal division pipeline has a robust value of more than INR 50 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With this, apart from this, in Bi-Metal division also, we are having a robust pipeline of more than INR 50 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The pipeline for brakes represents almost INR 10 crores for the next two years.
orders_capacity.quote: And that for the breaks, it is almost INR 10 crores for the next two years.

orders_capacity.claim: The current consolidated order position stands at more than INR 32 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: You see, our current order position is more than INR32 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded entirely through internal accruals without taking fresh loans.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared a dividend of Rs. 2 per share having face value of Re. 1 each.
capital_allocation.quote: Note: The Board has declared Dividend of Rs. 2 per share having face value of Re. 1 each

capital_allocation.claim: The company has taken INR 6 crores of loan from the bank under PCFC limits.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are going with PCFC limits, and we already talked, we have taken INR6 crores of loan from the bank so far as PCFC is concerned

capital_allocation.claim: Most of the planned capex will be financed with internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: and whatever capex is that we are going to do that most of it will be financed with internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were stuck for the last three months due to backlogs caused by the Strait of Hormuz and war.
risks_headwinds.quote: But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: In the tractor segment, a drought-like situation in some parts may affect demand to some extent.
risks_headwinds.quote: You see, considering the monsoon position that may -- in tractor segment affect today to some extent, not larger, because in some parts there is a drought-like situation, but it is expected to improve within this month or next month.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical situations and trade tariffs have caused some delays and volatility in raw material prices and export routes.
risks_headwinds.quote: Customers have, last 6, 8 months because of war and raw material prices increased, Donald Trump's tariffs, so customers have been a little bit slow.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export sales to African countries through Dubai were halted for three months, affecting business to the extent of almost INR 2 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: For last three months, we have -- that export is halted. That has affected to the extent of almost INR2 crores of business that we have lost during last three months.

management_commitments.claim: In the first year itself, management expects a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores from railways, eventually going up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within two years.
management_commitments.quote: and with this in the first year itself, we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

management_commitments.claim: The share of electric vehicles in the Alkop business is targeted to reach 8% to 10% by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: that in the Alkop business, the share of EV by FY27 end can be in the range of 8% to 10%.

management_commitments.claim: The dynamometer for the brake segment is expected to be commissioned by the end of August.
management_commitments.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving an asset turnover of 2 on a consolidated basis by 2028.
management_commitments.quote: By '28, we should be reaching that 100%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
